units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 3:2">Targ. Jer. III, 2</cite> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="A01248"><he>אֵיכָא</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 26:20">Targ. Prov. XXVI, 20</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="E00386"><he>הֵיכְנָא</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Berakhot 2a:6">Ber. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>תנא ה׳ קאי וכ׳</he> where does the Tannai (of the Mishnah) stand, that he starts with, ‘From what time’?, i.e. to what law does he refer?—
<cite ref="Yevamot 106a:11">Yeb. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>אבוך ה׳</he> where is thy father?—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 93a:6">Snh. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>לה׳ אזלו</he> where did they go to (what became of them)? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 93a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ודניאל לה׳ אזל</he> where was Daniel at the time?; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 11b:10">Ḥull. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ … דלא וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="E00378"><he>היכי</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="A02844"><he>אֶפְשַׁר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 2b:4">Yoma 2ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ דליכא דדמי ליה</he> where there is nothing resembling it.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 102a:23">B. Mets. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>כל ה׳ דאיהו וכ׳</he> in all cases in which he can acquire possession himself; a. v. fr.—Emph. <cite ref="E00385"><he>הֵיכָן</he></cite> (in Hebr. diction).
<cite ref="Pesachim 2b:6">Pes. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>וכי ה׳ מצינו</he> do we find anywhere &c.? <cite ref="Sukkah 23a:4">Succ. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ סוכתך</he> where is thy Succah?
